summary.text: Laurie Bratten is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 51, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Bratten worked in Colorado politics from 2008 to 2016, and before that she was a high school science teacher and a pharmaceutical salesperson.
From 2010 to 2014 she worked as a legislative aide in the Colorado State Legislature, first for state Sen. Ted Harvey and then for state Sen. Kent Lambert.
Bratten assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 6, 2025, succeeding Cyrus Western.
For 2025-2026, Bratten's committee assignments include the House Judiciary Committee and the House Education Committee.
